system.description:
Street swashbuckling: broken bottles, stolen coins, fighting dirty with style.

  • Anything Goes: Disarming Strike can target any held item (flask, key, document, pouch), not just weapons, and needs no save if your attack roll beats the target's AC by 5 or more.
    • 9th level: if you have a free hand, you may catch the item you knock loose.
  • Underclass Instinct: Advantage on checks to blend into the underclass, sell stolen goods, and deceive guards.
